description: Ordered recovery dependencies for the synthetic ledger. Order is part of the contract: data restored before its key or schema fails in ways that look like corruption.

steps.description: Isolated restore project exists and is empty
Encryption key is available and not scheduled for destruction
Protected artifact is readable from its retained location
Target schema is created at a version the restore tool can write
Artifact payload is decrypted and loaded
Reference data and configuration are applied
Application invariants are checked against the restored data
